Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the inspection checks
I1,
which must be performed on monthly bases as indicated by M1
in the title block. This procedure will be done as a first level of inspection
(Patrolling).
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Wearing Safety helmet is required.
Wear a musk.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set, SF6 gas detector, Blower and Musk.
Work to be Carried Out
Gas Pressure
Read and record the gas pressure , temperature and convert them on
 P/T characteristic curve in Fig 1at the temperature for 20 0C
 .The rated pressure is 6 kg/cm2 at 20 0C.
If SF6 Gas leak occur, supply SF6gas before the gas pressure drops
 to the alarm pressure. according to the following steps:-
Be careful not to inhale SF6 gas when discharging
 the gas for the purpose of replacing air in the supply hose with 
 SF6 gas
Be careful not to allow ingress of moisture
 into hose when connecting or disconnecting it.
Connect stop valve (904) using Fig 2 and SF6 gas cylinder using
 the gas supply hose.in this case loosely tighten the connecting fitting (923)
 of cylinder and hose to such an extent that gas leaks.
When installing gas C.B, open stop valve (904) Fig.2 and tighten
 stop valve of cylinder(923) while discharging the gas through the fitting part
 for connecting the cylinder and hose so as to replace the air in the hose with
 SF6 gas.
When supplying the gas, open stop valve (904) Fig.2 for about 5 seconds
 to replace the air inside the hose with SF6 gas and then tighten connecting
 fitting (923).
Open stop valve 921 of SF6 gas cylinder and supply SF6 gas .
When pressure reaches the working pressure (6 kg/cm2 for 500 kV circuit
 brekers,5 kg/cm2 for 220 and 132 kV circuit breakers ) , close stop valve 921
 ,904 and disconnect the supply hose .
Mount protective cover to stop valve 904 after disconnecting the hose
 without fail.
Air Pressure
Check
whether or not the pressure gauge indicates the specified value (18 kg /cm2 for
500kv Circuit Breaker , 15k.g/cm2 for 220kv, 132kv Circuit Breaker) if not, check whether the discrepancy
is due to a pressure gauge or pressure reducing valve disorder.
Check whether
or not a leakage noise audible around the sealed piping joints.
Operation Counter
Check and record the operation number.
Heaters
When humidity is high, the temperature drops sharply, or the
 temperature is low, turn on the heater for the control Box and control
 cabinet.
Drainage
Open the
drain valve of circuit breakers and air compressor receivers and
drain once every two weeks.
Others:
Check for signs
of abnormal noises in appearance.
